Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.5: Writing 3.5.1 Paragraphing: Sequencing of Ideas

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 3.5.1 Paragraphing: Sequencing of Ideas, part of Strand 3 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: how sequence of ideas. Why is it important to use conjunctions in writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 3.5.1 Paragraphing: Sequencing of Ideas together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Creativity and imagination: It is developed as the learner connects ideas creatively and sequentially in composition writing.

• Problem solving:It is achieved as the learner attempts to solve problems while forming paragraphs using conjunctions.

Values:
Unity: This is enriched as the learner works patiently with peers to identify conjunctions in paragraphs.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Critical and creative thinking skills: These are advanced as the learner practises connecting ideas logically in writing.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner relates the learning of conjuctions to their learning in Kiswahili.
